title: When, while and then
summary: Say **when** with `-AndA` (*öýe gelende*, *Aşgabada baranda*) and **while** or **when … was** with `-kA` (*çagakam*, *Çaý gyzgynka iç*), join actions with `-(Y)p` (*Bazara baryp, çörek aldym*), say what is going on now with *otyr*, *dur*, *ýatyr*, *ýör* (*okap otyr*, *ýagyp dur*), and tell a short story with *ilki*, *ondan soň*, *iň soňunda*.
canDo: Say when something happens or happened: when I get home, when I came to Turkmenistan
Talk about your childhood and student days: when I was a child, when I was a student
Say what someone is doing right now, sitting, standing, lying or these days
Tell a short story in order: first, then, after that, finally
